objective: Register, dry-run and then run the D51 re-measurement: arms A, D and F on all 25 questions x 3, and the D51 pipeline (E') on stage 1's seven x 3, under a $15.00 authorisation.
evidence: Predictions to pre-register: the same file, section 9 (sha256 prefix d0406b0a7e8cbc41 over the section text).
Decision table to pre-register: the same file, section 7 (sha256 prefix 64961cd5cd2b69a4).
Stage-1 baseline: docs/traces/20261005T215237Z-tier3-run.jsonl, sha256 d406f0fd59a7f499...; key-strict A 18, D 18, E 0 of 21.
Spend: the owner authorised $15.00 on 2026-10-14 ('ok on spend'). The gate line TIER3_SPEND_AUTHORIZED=15.00 in .env.tier3 is the owner's to set (G-3).

Arm E already runs the standing workflow (evals/tier3/runner.py _arm_e, workflow=None); after #176 that workflow is D51's engineering-rnd. Arm F is the same path with workflow verify-first (workflows/verify-first.yaml).

include: evals/tier3/runner.py — arm F; this stage's unit plan; the report tables below
evals/tier3/manifest.json — a new version for this run
docs/traces/ — the run's trace, after the run
exclude: autornd/ — the harness is frozen until this run is read.
evals/tier2/ — keys, questions and scorer frozen (D44).

constraints: ARMS: A = one call, pin TIER3_ARM_A, Q1-Q25 x 3, ceiling $0.10 per unit. D = one call, pin TIER3_ARM_D, Q1-Q25 x 3, ceiling $0.20. F = verify-first through arm E's path, standing tiers, Q1-Q25 x 3, ceiling $0.20. E' = arm E unchanged (D51's engineering-rnd), standing tiers, Q6 Q10 Q14 Q15 Q16 Q17 Q23 x 3, ceiling $0.50. Arms B and C do not run.
UNITS: 246 (75 + 75 + 75 + 21). Interleaved order, seed 20261014, recorded with its sha256 in the results header as stage 1 did.

UNCHANGED FROM STAGE 1: the 1800 s common deadline; A and D's registered call parameters (max_tokens 8000, temperature 0.3); the pins in .env.tier3; isolation per unit; retry rules; failure treatment.
SPEND: TIER3_SPEND_AUTHORIZED must equal 15.00 and the sweep budget cap is 15.00. No paid unit before the owner has set that line.
SCORING: the scorer version on main when the run starts (frozen-2026-10-03.3 after #171). Keys frozen v1. K1 is not ruled: report key-strict as primary and 3 s.f. side by side, as stage 1 did.

READING: the reading sheet holds every scorer FAIL and a seeded sample of 10 PASS per arm, without arm labels. Two independent readings (D50): the advisor's is reading 1, yours is reading 2. Commit yours before you open the advisor's.
PRE-REGISTRATION FIRST: commit section 9's nine predictions and section 7's decision table, verbatim, into the manifest and notebook section 113 before any paid unit. Never edit them afterwards.
NO git operation in the tree while the run writes. Do not start the run with a dirty tree.
DO NOT touch the harness. If the dry run finds a run-blocking harness defect, stop and report it; do not fix it under this command.
acceptance_criteria: (a) MANIFEST: a new version registering the arms, units, questions, seed, deadline, ceilings, the 15.00 authorisation, the scorer version and the reading rule exactly as in constraints.
(b) PLAN: the runner builds exactly 246 units in the seeded order. A guard test rebuilds the order independently and matches the sha256.
(c) ARM F: runs verify-first through arm E's path. A mocked F unit's record shows workflow verify-first, at most 4 model calls after triage and asks, and its iteration answers (first and final).

(d) RECORD (E' and F): each unit carries the anchored and demoted asks, every dissent with its anchor, the notes count, escalation's rulings, the candidate and every iteration's answer. Shown on mocked units.
(e) PRE-REGISTRATION: a test asserts the sha256 of the copied predictions and decision table equals that of sections 9 and 7 of the D51 record.
(f) DRY RUN: all 246 units mocked at zero spend. Each failure class occurs at least once: refusal, serving error, deadline, provider failure, budget stop. The reading sheet and report are generated.

(g) REPORT tables: delivered-correct of planned units per arm (key-strict and 3 s.f.); Q1-Q5 also shown separately; paired against A per question; median cost and latency per arm; F's first-answer vs final-answer table (prediction 9); unresolved candidates read (prediction 7); repetition agreement vs correctness (prediction 8); unanchored blocks per E'/F unit (prediction 3).
(h) PREFLIGHT passes free and prints each arm's worst case within its ceiling.
(i) Suite green before and after, counts re-derived, CI green. PR opened; the advisor merges.

(j) AFTER the merge and the owner's gate line: run the 246 units, copy the results to docs/traces/ byte-identical with its sha256, generate the reading sheet, and record spend, units and any failures in the response.

verification.expected: All pass; count reported before and after.
All pass, including the plan, order and pre-registration guards.

rollback: Before the run: revert the PR. After the run: not applicable — a measurement, bounded by the $15.00 sweep cap.
assumptions: The pins in .env.tier3 are the ones stage 1 used. If preflight shows a different serving, stop and report it.
The standing .env tiers serve E' and F. If the judge tier is unset, validate falls back as configured; report which serving judged.
Arm E's existing record fields from command 120 cover (d). If one is missing, add it in the runner's record (in scope) and report it.
questions: Report the expected spend from the dry run's worst cases and stage 1's medians. Do not adjust any ceiling.
